text: Dated: 21 May 2026
Rationale:
• Lenskart posted strong revenue growth of 41% yoy, driven by 44% yoy growth in the
India business and 35% yoy growth in the international business.
• India’s gross margin was flat yoy and EBITDA margin expanded 622 bps yoy, sharply
ahead of estimates.
• International gross margin/EBITDA margin increased 144/111 bps yoy and also beat
estimates.
• We upgrade FY27-28 EBITDA estimates by 5-6% as we bake in higher revenue growth
and margin expansion.
• This, coupled with the roll-forward, drives a revised DCF-based FV of Rs560 (Rs525
previously). Retain ADD.
Positives:
• Strong growth driven primarily by higher volumes in both India & international.
• Healthy margin improvement in both India and International businesses.
• Net addition of 604 stores in FY26; long-term margin ambition of ~25%.
• Balance sheet healthy with FCF generation.
• We model revenue growth of 22%/21% for India and international businesses,
respectively, over FY26-29.
• We model revenue CAGR of 23% and a PAT CAGR of 48% over FY26-29.
Negatives:
• Raw material costs. The broader geopolitical environment has put pressure on cross-
currency rates. This has flowed through to the cost of imports.
(EBITDA - Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization, EPS- Earning Per Share, CAGR - Compound Annual
Growth Rate, FCF – Free Cash Flow)
